turns.reply:
I changed `rich/padding.py` so the inner render width is clamped to at least 1, which stops padded content from disappearing when the padding is as wide as or wider than the available width. The existing padding tests pass, but this is a best guess: I could not match the issue text to a specific reproduction, so the hidden tests may expect different behaviour.

The clamp also means content can now render one column wider than `max_width` in that narrow case. I accepted that trade-off because the alternative was dropping the text entirely.
